title: Braking — Low Tyre Pressure Indication and Braking Technique on a Contaminated Runway
abstract: Crew procedure for a low tyre pressure indication before and during taxi, and for braking technique on a contaminated runway where cold brakes give less retardation than the crew expects.

sections.purpose: To give the crew the actions for a low tyre pressure indication and to set out the braking technique on a contaminated runway with cold brakes.
sections.description: On aircraft fitted with tyre pressure indicating, each of the six positions is shown on the wheel page with its pressure and a colour that reflects how far it is from the placard value. An amber value means the tyre is below the dispatch pressure but the aircraft is not restricted from taxiing; a red value means the position must be dealt with before flight. The indication is continuous and will change as the tyre warms up on the taxi, so a value that comes back into the green after ten minutes of taxi has not been fixed, it has simply warmed. On aircraft not fitted with the indicating system there is nothing to look at and the four-day manual check is the only evidence you have. On a contaminated runway the first application of the brakes with a cold carbon stack gives noticeably less retardation than the same application with the stack warm, and on a short cold sector the stack may never warm at all. That is a characteristic of the material and not a fault.
sections.crew_procedure: During the walk-around or on the wheel page, check all six positions. For an amber value, continue and report it at the next opportunity. For a red value, do not depart; call maintenance. Do not accept a value that has come back into the green during the taxi as evidence that the tyre is serviceable. On a contaminated runway, apply the brakes firmly and progressively at touchdown rather than gradually, expect less retardation from the first application on a cold stack, and be ready to use the full available length. Report any braking that feels asymmetric, with the runway condition and the outside air temperature.

type_data.crew_action: Check all six wheel positions before departure; apply firm progressive braking on a contaminated runway with a cold stack.
